tracked-two-authors/base.method: Independently viewed rendered Word-exported PDF page.
tracked-two-authors/base.observed: One portrait page with before, original body, and after on separate lines. Black regular text, no overlap.

tracked-two-authors/tracked.method: Independently viewed rendered Word-exported PDF page; final view does not display authors or revision balloons.
tracked-two-authors/tracked.observed: One portrait page. Middle paragraph reads author B inserted sentence, the first two characters of original body, then author A inserted sentence. The deleted original suffix is absent. Before/after are separate; no overlap.

tracked-two-authors/accepted.method: Independently viewed rendered Word-exported PDF page.
tracked-two-authors/accepted.observed: One portrait page. Final body matches tracked PDF: author B sentence, original two-character prefix, author A sentence. Both inserted sentences retained, deleted suffix absent. No overlap.

tracked-two-authors/rejected.method: Independently viewed rendered Word-exported PDF page.
tracked-two-authors/rejected.observed: One portrait page. Original body restored, both inserted sentences absent. Layout matches base with before and after on separate lines. No overlap.

sect-insert/before.method: Independently viewed rendered Word-exported PDF page.
sect-insert/before.observed: One portrait page. Before, first section text, second section text, after appear together as four separate lines. No overlap.

sect-insert/after.method: Independently viewed both rendered Word-exported PDF pages.
sect-insert/after.observed: Page 1 is portrait and contains before plus first section text. Page 2 is landscape and contains second section text plus after. All text visible with no overlap or blank filler page.

sect-delete/before.method: Independently viewed both rendered Word-exported PDF pages.
sect-delete/before.observed: Page 1 portrait with before and first section text; page 2 landscape with second section text and after. No overlap.

sect-delete/after.method: Independently viewed rendered Word-exported PDF page.
sect-delete/after.observed: One landscape page contains all four lines: before, first section text, second section text, after. Native section-break deletion retains the former second section's landscape page setup. No overlap.

z-order/before.method: Independently viewed rendered Word-exported PDF page, comparing visible occlusion with anchor positions in OOXML.
z-order/before.observed: One portrait page. Three teal/gold images step down and right. Middle image covers upper-left image; lower-right image covers middle. Thus visible back-to-front order is Picture 1, 2, 3. Before, Picture anchor and after remain readable.

z-order/after.method: Independently viewed rendered Word-exported PDF page, comparing visible occlusion with anchor positions in OOXML.
z-order/after.observed: One portrait page. Upper-left Picture 1 now covers the middle Picture 2; lower-right Picture 3 still covers Picture 2. Visible occlusion agrees with stored back-to-front order 2, 3, 1. All image positions and dimensions appear unchanged; text remains readable.

move-resize/before.method: Independently viewed rendered Word-exported PDF page.
move-resize/before.observed: One portrait page. One wide teal/gold picture sits below before/Picture anchor near the left margin; after is farther down. Picture is fully visible and text unobscured.

move-resize/after.method: Independently viewed rendered Word-exported PDF page and compared with before.
move-resize/after.observed: One portrait page. Same bitmap visibly moved down and right and shrunk to half width and height, preserving its wide aspect ratio. Before/Picture anchor and after remain unchanged and unobscured. Exact geometry is established separately by COM and OOXML.

para-split-merge/base.method: Independently viewed rendered Word-exported PDF page.
para-split-merge/base.observed: One portrait page. Before, original A paragraph, original B paragraph and after appear on four separate left-aligned lines. No overlap.

para-split-merge/tracked.method: Independently viewed rendered Word-exported PDF page; final view does not show revision balloons.
para-split-merge/tracked.observed: One portrait page. A paragraph is split after its second Chinese character; the remaining text is centered on the following line. B paragraph and after marker share a line. Before marker remains separate. No overlap. Exact two-character indentation is established by OOXML, not inferred from this centered-line image.

para-split-merge/accepted.method: Independently viewed rendered Word-exported PDF page.
para-split-merge/accepted.observed: One portrait page. Same split and centered continuation as tracked final view; B paragraph is merged with after marker on one line. No overlap.

para-split-merge/rejected.method: Independently viewed rendered Word-exported PDF page.
para-split-merge/rejected.observed: One portrait page. Original A paragraph restored as one left-aligned line; B paragraph and after marker are again separate. Layout matches base, with no centered line or overlap.

table-and-move/base.method: Independently viewed rendered Word-exported PDF page.
table-and-move/base.observed: One portrait page. Two-column three-row table contains A1/B1, A2/B2, A3/B3. Before sits above; movable paragraph and after marker sit below. Clear borders and no overlap.

table-and-move/tracked.method: Independently viewed rendered Word-exported PDF page; final view does not show revision balloons or duplicate move source.
table-and-move/tracked.observed: One portrait page. First row merged across both columns, with A1 and B1 stacked; second row reads Inserted A/Inserted B; third row A2/B2. Original row three absent. One movable paragraph immediately precedes after below the table. No overlap.

table-and-move/accepted.method: Independently viewed rendered Word-exported PDF page.
table-and-move/accepted.observed: One portrait page. Same table and body layout as tracked final view: merged first row A1/B1 stacked, inserted row retained, A2/B2 last, A3/B3 absent. One movable paragraph precedes after. No overlap.

table-and-move/rejected.method: Independently viewed rendered Word-exported PDF page.
table-and-move/rejected.observed: One portrait page. Inserted row removed and A3/B3 restored below A2/B2. First row remains merged with A1 and B1 stacked, so this native Word rejection is not visually identical to base. One movable paragraph precedes after. No overlap.

run-edits/base.method: Independently viewed rendered Word-exported PDF page.
run-edits/base.observed: One portrait page. Before marker, the three original Chinese sentences, and after marker appear as three separate paragraphs. Black regular body text; no overlap.

run-edits/tracked.method: Independently viewed rendered Word-exported PDF page; final view does not show revision balloons.
run-edits/tracked.observed: One portrait page. Middle paragraph shows first original sentence, inserted sentence, and third original sentence. Third-sentence keyword is visibly bold red; the remainder is black. Second original sentence is absent. Before/after markers visible; no overlap.

run-edits/accepted.method: Independently viewed rendered Word-exported PDF page.
run-edits/accepted.observed: One portrait page. Accepted text matches tracked final-view content: first original sentence, inserted sentence, third original sentence. Third-sentence keyword bold red. Second original sentence absent. Before/after markers visible; no overlap.

run-edits/rejected.method: Independently viewed rendered Word-exported PDF page.
run-edits/rejected.observed: One portrait page. Three original sentences restored, all visibly black regular text, and inserted sentence absent. Layout matches base; before/after markers visible; no overlap.
